lines.text: Three more kings will arise in Persia, and a fourth, far richer than the others, will stir up everyone against Greece.
One from her family line will enter the North's fortress and take their gods captive to Babylon.
The king of the North will capture a fortified city, settle in the Beautiful Land, and offer a daughter in marriage.
The king of the South will mobilize a very large army, but those who eat his provisions will seek to destroy him.
Ships of Tarshish will come against the king of the North, and he will lose heart and turn back.
